### 2026-10-06 – # October 6: Schematics for ESP32 S3 Done!!

**3h**

# October 6: Schematics for ESP32 S3 Done!!

I just finished schematics for ESP32 S3 devkit on KiCAD! This is my first time making something with so many ICs on KiCAD so I am really excited.

To make the schematic, I needed some schematics for an existing devkit, luckily for me, these are readily available!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/7a1b250b2ca6b63328f0ae2df899a5f40c1970d693ea93c804d2498e9f75d5af.png)

So I spent some time to translate these into KiCAD schematic

Something interesting that occured was that the PDFs I was referencing used Micro-USB, and I wanted the devboard to use USB-C, So I found some schematics for this, hopefully it doesnt break :D

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/2955036570ed7d8911a79a94ec60b5729e6ab0a7e3233b25492020c506b62ac7.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/00b3c6d344dbff00869296bf1026e3b6a85a1dd86f218225a7d73c33d7699f26.png)

I still need to map the pinouts, and I do wish to have a row of female pin headers above for easy SPI/TFT/OLED screen attachment, goals for tomorrow!!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/5774baaed8cf07e4a7d243cfc2f0ddc20fdc0d5afe8e8374a8f5fa0e15d0cfb3.png)

tl;dr I mapped out most of the schematics for the devboard and spent time to find micro-USB to USB-c docs, meaning I can start on recharging and pinouts, as well as PCB soon.

**Time Spent: 3 Hours**

### 2026-10-11 – PCB finished!

**6h**

PCB finished!

Today I finished up the PCB and updated the repo. I have also gotten my BOM ready.

But before that, I had to add pin headers to my devboard(else it wouldnt really be a devboard yk)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/bb938e496cff46dbbe44626df4a227061e11b6d83d46a15467e305dfed3aecb1.png)

Once that was settled I assigned footprints. Apparently, my esp32 module footprint was giving me problems with the footprint and symbol, so I switched to the kicad standard and fixed that up.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/87001ab25479f254d40525336c3b97ddf101609da3ac74752f7bebb0a994fcad.png)

Now I started positioning components, this part is hard to explain, I just relied on intuition to make the positioning optimal.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/16c055662eb661a0c95b3c9029d702c0e059e16315fc9be4acfd70c8e84cf799.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/4993a9ff668c72f824879c77fc6d01754158830e925da13ca3799a4ae131cc61.png)

Tracing!(I had spent A LOT of time figuring out differential pairs for D+ and D-) and this whole experience was really eye opening to how complex PCB routing is.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/3eaaa1ca20a668e08ce7f3826c291739c93d5e74db9fcb8a4a4f0d07c0ec3838.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/4eb8ed8389149641b8eb21d6e46b20013cf320b7aa73c3a3169ed0041b4e591e.png)
Beautiful Differential pairs right?

Anyways after PAINFUL tracing and screaming at the DRC(including some funny ground fills and a LOT of vias), my PCB passes DRC!
